headers.//: C1 contract 2, half of it. Astro with output:'static' writes files, not response headers, so the RFC 8288 alternate link is host configuration and can only live here. Without it a sibling .md is undiscoverable to anything that does not already know the convention.
The other half. Served as text/markdown so a fetch renders as source rather than downloading, and cached hard because the content hash is in the path's own history, not a query string.
The corpus files (C4). Plain text, and explicitly crawlable — they exist to be read by machines.

form-action carries buttondown.email because the waitlist form (T2.2) POSTs there directly — no runtime of ours, no database, no GDPR surface owned here. style-src allows inline because Expressive Code sets per-token colours as style attributes; script-src does NOT, and the site ships no inline script beyond the pre-paint theme block, which is hashed at T1.3.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; base-uri 'self'; object-src 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; form-action 'self' https://buttondown.email
